about: When a new planner day begins. dayStart is minutes after midnight: -60 is 11 PM the evening before, 120 (2 AM) is the default, 240 is 4 AM, in 30-minute steps. A moment belongs to the planner day of the calendar day it falls on after moving it back by dayStart minutes. Times are local and avoid daylight-saving changes. Unknown values fall back to 120.

cases.name: 1:30 AM still counts as the day before with the 2 AM default
midnight start is the calendar day
4 AM start keeps 3:59 AM on the day before
11 PM start begins tomorrow in the evening
11 PM start leaves 10:59 PM on the same day
an unknown value uses the 2 AM default
